_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 16 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). TWO cells from 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-15 analysis @f818ebd12b. Round 15 STANDS; D1R15-AC4 PASS accepted; no PRD addendum owed.

what_round_15_left.claim: held -- 3.0.0_SA_CVO's L9 @c6ac61b33a, adopted by the CTO's analysis
what_round_15_left.the_residual_verbatim: 'RETIRED' IS A FACT ABOUT THE SWEEP RECORD AND NOT A FACT ABOUT THE INSTRUMENT. p37-producers still sits in the tree and still returns PASS to anyone who runs it -- I just did, and nothing in its output says it was retired. A reader who reaches the instrument without reaching DISCRIMINATOR_SWEEP_R15.json gets a green from a detector the estate has formally retired.
what_round_15_left.and_why_it_could_not_be_closed_in_round_: the three retired CMDs live in check_en_r13.py, a PINNED FIXED INPUT of a CLOSED round. Editing it after that round's proofs were pinned against it is the stale-proof hazard this project runs an arm for -- so a re-point would not merely change nothing graded, it would ACTIVELY ENDANGER something graded.

cell_1_the_marker.verbatim: The RETIRED.md sibling marker -- additive, fixed_inputs/r13/, owner 2.0.0_SA_COO~G. Cheapest item in the round and it closes a residual the grader could only name.
cell_1_the_marker.why_a_SIBLING_and_not_an_edit: it is ADDITIVE. A new file beside the checker discloses the retirement to anyone who opens the directory WITHOUT touching a byte of the pinned input, so round 13's proofs stay resolvable and the stale-proof arm has nothing to fire on.
cell_1_the_marker.THE_ARM_PROVES_THE_ADDITIVITY_RATHER_THA: the criterion requires the record to carry the checker's blob hash at its round-13 pin AND at HEAD, and refuses unless they are IDENTICAL. That is the stale-proof protection made mechanical instead of promised.
cell_1_the_marker.what_it_does_NOT_close: a reader who runs the CMD without opening the directory still gets a green. The marker raises the floor; it does not reach the instrument's own output. The order says so rather than overselling it, and the census cell is where the class is measured.

cell_2_the_census.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO @f818ebd12b s.5 item 2, with the LGCTFM r7 analysis s.5 item 4
cell_2_the_census.verbatim: THE GENERALISATION IS THE VALUABLE PART, and it is bigger than this control. The class is: an instrument that has been RETIRED IN A RECORD but is STILL RUNNABLE FROM THE TREE. Round 15 found one by accident, because the CVO re-ran it. A census of the class is a round-16 cell: every fixed_inputs/ checker across LGIC whose retiring record exists, measured against whether the instrument itself discloses it. Denominator printed.
cell_2_the_census.THE_DOMAIN_IS_THE_TRAP_AND_THE_CTO_NAMED: ⛔ The subtraction's domain is `fixed_inputs/` ACROSS THE PROJECT, NOT THE RETIRED LIST -- reading the retired list can only find retirements someone already wrote down, which is the understated-by-its-own-instrument shape this project has now hit twice.
cell_2_the_census.and_it_is_cut_ONCE_ACROSS_BOTH_PROJECTS: LGIC_LGCTFM r7 analysis s.5 item 4: 'LGCTFM carries fixed_inputs/ too, and the census should be cut once across both projects rather than twice.' So this cell's denominator spans LGIC_ENFORCE AND LGIC_LGCTFM.
cell_2_the_census.the_three_classes: RETIRED-AND-DISCLOSED (a retiring record exists AND the instrument itself says so), RETIRED-BUT-SILENT (a retiring record exists and the instrument does not -- THE HAZARD), and LIVE (no retiring record). MECE over the printed denominator, by subtraction.

ZERO_IS_ADMISSIBLE_ON_BOTH_CELLS.statement: If the census finds NO retired-but-silent instrument beyond the one round 15 already named, that PASSES, with its own positive arm. What is refused is a denominator that came from the retired list rather than from fixed_inputs/, or an arithmetic that does not close.
ZERO_IS_ADMISSIBLE_ON_BOTH_CELLS.why_it_matters_here: the cell is measuring a class this fabric has already been embarrassed by. A bar that only passed on finding more would be an instruction to find more.

the_cut_rule_carried_from_the_SIBLING_pr.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO, LGIC_LGCTFM r7 analysis s.5 item 3, stated as binding on the CTO and adopted here by this seat
the_cut_rule_carried_from_the_SIBLING_pr.statement: A cell whose success will not move the metric its sponsor watches must SAY SO IN THE CELL. One sentence at the cut; it costs nothing and it prevents a correct cell being read as a failure.
the_cut_rule_carried_from_the_SIBLING_pr.non_application: a cell whose output IS the metric
the_cut_rule_carried_from_the_SIBLING_pr.applied_to_cell_1: the marker does NOT make p37-producers stop returning PASS. Anyone who runs the CMD still gets a green. If the metric watched is 'does the instrument mislead a runner', THIS CELL DOES NOT MOVE IT -- and the order says so in those words.
the_cut_rule_carried_from_the_SIBLING_pr.applied_to_cell_2: the census MEASURES the class; it repairs nothing. Its output IS its metric, so the non-application clause covers it -- stated rather than left silent.

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the repaired predicate with both residuals
stale_proof_bar.statement: SET EQUALITY against the proofs that could actually be stale; the COUNT is informational; a failed retrieval RAISES; ONE ordered git log over all watched paths.

not_in_this_round_and_why.editing check_en_r13.py or any other pin: REFUSED. It is the stale-proof hazard the round-15 L9 named, and cell 1's own arm proves the checker's bytes did not move.
not_in_this_round_and_why.repairing any retired-but-silent instrum: the census MEASURES. A remedy is decided on the measurement, by the CTO, and deciding it inside the measuring cell is how a round makes the numbers agree instead of the data.
not_in_this_round_and_why.the LGCTFM round-8 acts: a different project's round. Measured at this cut and recorded in the drive log: 18 rows name this seat by OWNERSHIP but only 11 are ACTS -- the other 7 are retirements whose act is a disposition.
